title: EU, FE, J and conversion policy

blocks.text: Calculator stores FE internally. Native adapters accept or send supported external units at the boundary. EU is therefore an accepted connection type, not a replacement for the internal buffer.

rows: NeoForge FE
Native FE input/output. RF/IF/CF branding is compatible only where that mod exposes FE.
GregTech CEu
EU packets with voltage and amperage limits; separate native battery rules.
Mekanism
Joules via native machine and item APIs.
Modern Industrialization
EU via the MI energy API.
GrandPower
Long-valued FE API with a 1:1 base unit.
Applied Energistics 2
AE-powered items only; not a direct native grid port.

blocks.text: Each native adapter has independent block-port and item-charging gates, input/output gates, and applicable loss settings. Input means native energy enters Foundations storage, including discharging an external battery. Output means Foundations energy leaves storage, including charging an external battery.

rows: compat.gtceu.fePerEU
0 inherits the higher of GT direction ratios; a positive integer fixes FE per EU.
power.mekanism.joulesPerFE
0 inherits Mekanism; a positive decimal fixes J per FE.
power.modernIndustrialization.fePerEU
0 inherits MI; a positive decimal fixes FE per EU.
compat.aeEnergyToFE
FE per AE for powered items.

blocks.text: Voltage is packet size and amperage is packet count per tick. Neither is the EU/FE exchange rate. Port capacity, side modes, native item tier restrictions and shared packet budgets still apply.
